title: Harlan Insurance · Claims Department
L: Dear Mr. Adebayo, Thank you for contacting Harlan Insurance about your recent claim.
We have received the photographs of the damage to your car, and our team has reviewed them carefully.
Based on this review, we have approved your claim for $1,250.
This amount covers the full cost of the repairs.
The payment will be sent to your bank account within five business days.
If you have any questions, please call our customer service line at 555-0193.
Please have your claim number ready when you call.

exq.why: Câu sau nói đã duyệt hồ sơ dựa trên việc xem xét này → việc xem ảnh đã xong: has reviewed.

exq.a: This amount covers the full cost of the repairs.
w: Photographs must be taken in good light.
Your bank account was opened five years ago.
Our customer service line is closed today.
exq.why: "This amount" chỉ khoản $1,250 vừa nêu; "tổng đài đóng cửa" mâu thuẫn với lời mời gọi điện ở sau.
Nếu có thắc mắc thì gọi → If; Unless / Although sai nghĩa, Whether cần or.
have + tân ngữ + tính từ (have your claim number ready = chuẩn bị sẵn mã hồ sơ) → ready.
